europe_now.title: Escalating Student Protests in France
europe_now.summary: France faces growing social unrest as student demonstrations result in over four hundred detentions amid school blockades and fires. The demonstrations reflect heightened domestic tensions linked to ongoing fiscal and public policy pressures.

sources.headline: More than 400 detained as France student protests escalate
Fires and blockades as students stage school protests across France

europe_now.title: Russian Missile Strikes Hit Kyiv
europe_now.summary: Several individuals have been killed following a fresh wave of Russian missile attacks targeting the Ukrainian capital. The ongoing bombardment continues to severely impact regional security and infrastructure.

sources.headline: Live: Several people killed as Russia launches new round of strikes on Kyiv

top_stories.title: European Union Budgetary Debates
top_stories.summary: Governments across Europe are preparing for potential major reductions in the upcoming EU budget proposal. The anticipated funding adjustments threaten to significantly impact regional development and agricultural support.

sources.headline: Governments brace for €100B cut to EU budget proposal
Frugal EU states seeking budget cuts are shooting their own regions in the foot

top_stories.title: UK Relations with the European Union
top_stories.summary: Senior British figures are discussing potential pathways for future cooperation and closer ties with the European Union. These proposals indicate a shift in political discourse regarding the UK's long-term international alignment.
